questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Single-index access” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.
questions.answer_key: Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.
questions.explanation: Single-index access: Write down the expected axes and element count, then assert the observed shape. For layout-related topics, also check contiguity and whether storage is shared.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Multidimensional indexing”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: print or assert shape, dtype, and expected values after every shape-changing or reduction operation.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Slices and ranges”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not reshape a tensor by guessing dimensions; preserve the element count and verify the resulting axis meanings.
